gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-glegoo: Glegoo's serif letters have big counters and curves that never quite close their mouths, for a refined, editorial feel. But paragraph after paragraph would flow easily beneath Woodgod, whose vintage display letters carry the commanding tone.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a traditional serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on the s, refined without fuss. Woodgod then adds commanding, vintage weight on top, its tall lowercase nearly touching the capitals.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-kadwa: Woodgod swaggers in, vintage and commanding, with tall lowercase. Kadwa, a classic text serif whose curves stay open-ended and whose x-height runs large, carries paragraphs with an easy, unhurried flow.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-piazzolla: A wide channel runs into every bowl of Woodgod's letters. Piazzolla, refined and authoritative, keeps its lowercase close to capital height and pries its e wide open, so that vintage swagger has a worthy partner.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-scope-one: Woodgod brings commanding, vintage display letters whose lowercase nearly reaches the capitals. Scope One, a traditional serif with spilling counters and stubby ascenders, would carry a page of text with refined ease.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-slabo-13px: Woodgod's lowercase climbs almost to capital height, and a wide channel opens into every bowl. Slabo 13px brings dignified, bookish openness through large counters, and that clarity is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified is the word for Suwannaphum, a serif whose c is as open as a bent paperclip and whose x-height reaches high. Beside Woodgod's commanding letters, that woodblock solidity is the pair's real strength.
gen-dafont-woodgod-inter: Inter draws smooth, tube-like lines with counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Inter lets Woodgod's commanding, vintage letters take the lead while its cord-like rounded strokes stay in the background.
gen-dafont-woodgod-mulish: Every bowl on Woodgod gets a wide, carved-out channel. Mulish, a modern sans with no stroke modulation and horseshoe-open apertures, stays approachable beside Woodgod's command, and that gap is the pair's draw.
gen-eater-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, leaving generous space where curves meet the stem. Bespoke Sans would read smoothly across paragraphs beneath Eater's dark, aggressive, widely spaced letters.
